calibration: Sigmoid (Platt) map fitted on a separate calibration partition.
data_citation: Mohanad Sarhan, Siamak Layeghy and Marius Portmann. Towards a Standard Feature Set for Network Intrusion Detection System Datasets. Mobile Networks and Applications (2022). https://doi.org/10.1007/s11036-021-01843-0
data_terms: NF-UNSW-NB15-v2, University of Queensland: permitted re-use with commercial use restriction. Academic use requires the citation; commercial use requires the authors' agreement.
explanations: Per-flow reason codes are disabled until explanation stability is proven.
input_contract: published raw units; finite non-negative numeric values
limitations: no temporal or capture-session split is possible from published columns
name: NetFlow v2 triage classifier (LightGBM, behaviour-only features)

policies.max_macro_f1: Threshold that maximised validation macro F1
policies.strict_fpr_0.001: Maximum recall with validation false-positive rate <= 0.001

shortcut_audit.reading: TTL-based features alone separate this corpus well, so high scores partly reflect laboratory artefacts. Removing them costs little macro F1, but same-corpus results do not establish generalisation to other networks.

status: Research demonstrator. The frozen policy states: not approved for deployment.
